    $$1 \text{ carton} \times 20 \text{ jars} = 20 \text{ damaged jars}$$

**Total damaged jars:**
$$15 + 20 = 35 \text{ damaged jars}$$

**Step 4: Calculate the number of good jars.**
Subtract the damaged jars from the total jars.
$$600 \text{ (Total)} - 35 \text{ (Damaged)} = 565$$

**Answer:**
There were **565** jars of milk good for sale that week.
